title: My journey to create character animation workflow
author: LegendaryJohnny
selftext:
So my goal is to create 3D or 2D character animation without using paid stuff like Meshy. Meshy is obviously great choice and results are pretty amazing in very short time, but I would like to create my own workflow which will get to similar results for free. And I am getting there.

First of all, my plan is to create pixelated 2D character with 8 directions and AI suggested to create 3D first and then create 2D moveset from that. Games like Hades or Dead Cells used this method.

I was naive and wanted to try something simple, so I asked ChatGPT to create character moveset, which it did, but after implementing, in my demo game it looked like character is just floating through space without any movement - so not a good option. Then I suggested to take some sprites ChatGPT created and just cut body parts and create puppet like animation. It could work in theory, but it looks terrible (like those cheap cash grab mobile games):

https://i.redd.it/0taix86mx2wh1.png

Then I tried using ComfyAI and image to video generation. Result was decent, but character model was just moving too inconsistently and turning his body and head. Claude on Opus 5.5 was able to create decent animation:

https://i.redd.it/j6pyxki1y2wh1.png

It looked decent in game engine and if this method is tweaked and you can download Wan model and reference video to video workflow for Comfy UI so you have like 7 second looping animation of walking, while claude prepares reference video for it, then it could work well, but seems like too much struggle and steps. So I tried something else.

  
I created T pose images of the character, downloaded Blender and ask Claude to create walking and running character from scratch, without any plugins and other stuff, default Blender, one T pose. Result was decent but unusable:

https://i.redd.it/76eyiv8my2wh1.png



Asked claude to fix weird head and stiffness and the result was not much better:

https://i.redd.it/mry2pl9wy2wh1.png



So in next step I downloaded motion capture data for walking and running. Results are much better with it:

https://i.redd.it/c8vsh3koz2wh1.png



Body and bending is still very unnatural, so next step was downloading open sourced human body anatomy for Blender. It fixed something, but still weird shoulders etc.

https://i.redd.it/hw2lpql303wh1.png



  
Acording to Claude it is because of T pose - when the arms are put down, it creates deformed shoulders, so now we downloaded open source pack for clothing and I will need to create new character poses, then it should look really decent even without using Meshy or similar paid stuff for 3D models (which you need to make moving somehow anyway).

To sum it up - this is good method to create 2D movesets with consistency. Claude will just pixelate it how you want (some of the images above are already pixelated by claude a little) and then it will create movesets how you want. 8 directions, 4 directions, frames per second as you wish. Imo better option then other methods I saw here.

replies.author: LegendaryJohnny
replies.body:
Yes I tried today to improve it. It absolutely works if you want to pixelate character later, but HD 3D model still needs a lot of tweaking. The advantage here is that the clothes on the character is swappable. It is not part of the 3D body. If you create character in paid AI tools, it will just put texture on a 3D model. Here you can see my last character result, then pixelation, then how it looks ingame in my demo area. You can compare it to his Wife, which is still my very first attempt - pure ChatGPT prompt - create 2D moveset in 8 directions. It looks terrible in comparison. Outside area is created purely by Claude doing simple 3D blocks, just for having swap between areas. Anyway, here is the result after very short work and very little tweaking:

https://reddit.com/link/phe3u2w/video/k5nsogzeu3wh1/player

replies.author: LegendaryJohnny
replies.body: 2D concept of character on ChatGPT - A-Pose from front, back, side, transparent background, hi-res. Give it to Claude Code (dorect him to folder where it is saved). Give Claude folder of Blender, ask him how can you make natural character with real motion cap with open source tool for blender, he will recommend you some open source human models, allow him to download, then ask him about motion caputure, he will give you link for open source database with a loooot of captured motions - download what you need - walk, run, sitting etc. Then you are good to go - let claude work on it, adjust result by prompts, tell him to do 2d motion sheet and thats it.
